text:
maria (docs): PR #842 up — refresh Starter Run guide to use short-lived tokens and consolidated SDK snippets. Need a final pass on the auth example and Dockerfile tweak. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :eyes:

aj (eng): taking a look now. Quick Q: which runtime image should the Dockerfile reference? Current base in the PR is `redwood/serve:0.9`.

maria (docs): ideally use `redwood/inference-runtime:1.2.2-prod` — that matches Dedicated. Also swapped env var from `REDWOOD_API_KEY` -> `REDWOOD_TOKEN` per new auth. Need to show the audience header usage too.

sam (devex): can we include both JS and TS snippets? Tiny TS sample would help. Also CI needs a step to set `REDWOOD_TOKEN` via secrets in GitHub Actions. I'll drop a GH Actions snippet suggestion. :+1:

tasha (qa): I ran the guide locally — `make start` fails on Windows PowerShell because of the `export` line. Recommend adding a Windows note and a PowerShell example.

aj (eng): noted. Regarding token flow: backend now requires an audience header. Update the examples to include headers: `Authorization: Bearer ${token}` and `X-Client-Audience: my-app`.

maria (docs): added that header in the PR but the code block got a little cluttered. Current snippet in the PR:

```js
const res = await fetch('/api/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN}`,
    'X-Client-Audience': 'starter-web'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt })
})
```

Any suggestions?

aj (eng): looks good. Suggest adding a one-line note about short TTL tokens and linking to the refresh-token endpoint. Also for clarity, show `const token = await getShortLived()` in a preceding snippet.

ci-bot: GitHub Actions found a lint error in `docs/guide/starter-run.md` line 128: MD012/no-multiple-blanks. See https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions/123456

maria (docs): fixing lint now.

sam (devex): for Typescript add this minimal snippet to the SDK examples section:

```ts
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN })
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b', input: 'Hello' })
```

And note the optional types package as a devDependency: `@redwood/inference-types`.

tasha (qa): after I updated the guide with this PowerShell line the app boots on Windows:

```powershell
$env:REDWOOD_TOKEN = 'you-token-here'
npm run start
```

Please add that exact block to avoid more confusion.

aj (eng): one more small runtime nit: Dockerfile ENTRYPOINT for local dev runs should pass `--no-telemetry` so it doesn't attempt telemetry during CI/local smoke tests. Also check the image tag pin — use `1.2.2-prod` not `:latest` in the example.

maria (docs): pushed fixes (lint, PowerShell note, TS snippet, audience header, Docker image pin). PR now shows checks green except perf-check which flakes sporadically.

devex-bot: Reminder: update `docs/CHANGELOG.md` with a one-line summary for the quickstart refresh. Suggested: `2026-03-21 - Starter Run: switch to short-lived tokens; add TS snippet; Windows PowerShell note.`

maria (docs): added changelog line.

aj (eng): review done, approved. :thumbsup: I can merge after squash. Anyone want to do the merge or shall I?

sam (devex): I can do the merge and will re-run the perf-check jobs post-merge.

tasha (qa): I'll re-run local smoke and post a short note in #docs when everything is green on my side.

maria (docs): thanks everyone! I'll also update the internal onboarding deck with the new snippets tomorrow and ping product.
